name: Scripted sessions right on every surface, with the structure in view
purpose: A person working with the AI while it works can watch, stop, resume, steer, approve and read the result on a terminal and through a separate frontend, and can see which solutions the work serves.
record: Draft: no cases or runs of its own yet. It is read from the authoritative metrics of its three parts (metric-terminal-session, metric-frontend-interface, metric-structure-in-view), each on its own scripted cases, and the composition arm is covered by a unit test.
disadvantages: It sees scripted sessions and the contract, not whether a person finds a screen clear; a real session on a real frontend is a later stage.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the scripted cases of the three parts pass] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real session of a real harness is shown on this surface and hand-read]
